name: Factor Analysis
when_to_use: Many metric variables correlated with each other (e.g., questionnaire items); reduce to a few latent factors that explain the common pattern, with adequacy checks (KMO, Bartlett's test of sphericity) before extraction.

expected_input.question: Which latent dimensions explain the correlation among many observed variables?

plain_explanation.purpose: Discovers a few hidden factors that explain the answers to many questions.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When several questions measure the same concept, such as satisfaction, and you want to confirm it.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with many correlated numeric columns, such as questionnaire scores.
plain_explanation.example: Reduce 15 survey questions to 3 dimensions: price, service, product.
